name: @sentinel/module-setup
description: Sentinel module: the §14.28 setup layer's pure decision surface (D-049) — the command validators (tenant, user, limits; the SETUP_* refusal family), the role ladder as data, and the wizard's remainingSteps derivation (§14.10's first-run states are DATA, never decoration). Pure and deterministic: the timezone allowlist is injected, the unique-key collisions are the database's to surface by name, the credential's policy floor is the auth module's.
